query: What Monte Carlo ensemble sizes and sampling distributions are recommended to robustly propagate membership-function and weight uncertainty for spatial P estimates?

response.query: What Monte Carlo ensemble sizes and sampling distributions are recommended to robustly propagate membership-function and weight uncertainty for spatial P estimates?
response.answer: For robust uncertainty propagation in spatial P estimates, use a Monte Carlo ensemble size of at least 1,000 samples and a uniform sampling distribution. Larger ensembles improve accuracy.

results.title: Evidential Deep Learning: Enhancing Predictive Uncertainty ...
results.content: Parametric deep learning can estimate uncertainty with one model by predicting the parameters of a probability distribution but does not account for epistemic uncertainty. Through applications of the classification of winter precipitation type and regression of surface-layer fluxes, we show evidential deep learning models attaining predictive accuracy rivaling standard methods while robustly quantifying both sources of uncertainty.
